moments.title: The Hundred Final
moments.blurb: The Hundred men's and women's cricket finals will be held at Lord's in London this Sunday, August 16, crowning the 2026 champions.

angles.name: Finals Day Buzz
angles.copy: Who's taking home The Hundred trophy this Sunday? The Men's and Women's Finals hit Lord's on August 16th!

angles.name: Lord's Hosts
angles.copy: The Home of Cricket, Lord's, is ready for The Hundred Finals this weekend. Expect fireworks!

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21, with Arsenal hosting Coventry City.

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: That's it, the wait is almost over! The Premier League is back on August 21st. Who's ready for kick-off?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry City kicks off the new Premier League season on August 21st. Big opening fixture!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history, securing a record-breaking 20th non-consecutive week at Number 1 on the Official Singles Chart.

angles.name: Longest No.1 Ever
angles.copy: 20 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean have officially made history with 'Rein Me In' becoming the UK's longest-running chart-topper. Incredible!

angles.name: Juggernaut Song
angles.copy: Is 'Rein Me In' the song of the decade? Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's collaboration is still dominating the charts after 20 weeks!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's Chart Domination
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande has two new entries in the Official UK Top 40 this week with 'petal' and 'kiss me', alongside her album 'Petal' hitting Number 1.

angles.name: Ariana's Double Drop
angles.copy: Two new entries AND a Number 1 album! Ariana Grande is having a massive week on the UK charts with 'petal' and 'kiss me' making waves.

angles.name: Album & Singles Success
angles.copy: Queen of the charts! Ariana Grande's 'Petal' is the UK's Number 1 album, while two new singles climb the Top 40. What's your favourite new track?

moments.title: UK basks in August heatwave
moments.blurb: Much of England and Wales is set for a heatwave this week, with temperatures potentially reaching the mid-30s in the south, while Scotland and Northern Ireland remain cooler.

angles.name: Heatwave Incoming
angles.copy: Get ready for a sizzling week! England and Wales are bracing for a heatwave, with temperatures climbing towards the mid-30s. Stay cool out there!

angles.name: Sunshine & High Temps
angles.copy: Sun's out, thermometers are up! We're in for a very warm week across much of the UK. How are you beating the heat?

moments.title: Wales schools return this week
moments.blurb: Summer holidays are wrapping up for pupils in Wales, with many schools returning to classes around August 11th.

angles.name: Back to School Wales
angles.copy: It's back to school for many in Wales this week! Wishing all pupils a great start to the new academic year.

angles.name: Summer's End Wales
angles.copy: Did your summer fly by? For Welsh students, it's time to head back to the classroom this week. Best of luck everyone!

moments.title: Happy 58th Michael Bivins
moments.blurb: Michael Bivins, founding member of New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe, turns 58 today.

angles.name: R&B Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the legendary Michael Bivins of New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe! What's your favourite track from his incredible career?

moments.title: Happy 62nd Neneh Cherry
moments.blurb: Swedish singer-songwriter and rapper Neneh Cherry celebrates her 62nd birthday today.

angles.name: Buffalo Stance Star
angles.copy: Happy 62nd Birthday to the iconic Neneh Cherry! From 'Buffalo Stance' to '7 Seconds,' her music still sounds fresh.

moments.title: Happy 79th Ian Anderson
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, the legendary frontman and flautist of Jethro Tull, turns 79 today.

angles.name: Rock Flute Legend
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to Jethro Tull's incredible Ian Anderson! The man who made the flute a rock instrument. What's your favourite Tull track?

moments.title: Happy 68th Madonna
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, will celebrate her 68th birthday on Saturday, August 16.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Madonna turns 68 this Saturday! Celebrate the Queen of Pop by cranking up your favourite of her hits.

moments.title: Happy 73rd James 'J.T.' Taylor
moments.blurb: James 'J.T.' Taylor, the iconic lead singer of Kool & the Gang, celebrates his 73rd birthday on Saturday, August 16.

angles.name: Kool & the Gang Legend
angles.copy: Get down on it! Happy 73rd Birthday to James 'J.T.' Taylor, the voice behind so many Kool & the Gang classics, this Saturday!

moments.title: Happy 58th MC Eric (Technotronic)
moments.blurb: Welsh rapper and singer MC Eric, also known as Me One from Technotronic, celebrates his 58th birthday on Monday, August 18.

angles.name: Pump Up The Jam Birthday
angles.copy: Pump up the jam, pump it up! Happy 58th Birthday to Cardiff's own MC Eric (Me One of Technotronic) this Monday!

angles.name: Welsh Dance Icon
angles.copy: Shout out to Welsh dance music pioneer MC Eric, celebrating his 58th birthday on August 18th! What a legacy.

moments.title: Happy 76th Dennis Elliott (Foreigner)
moments.blurb: Dennis Elliott, the original drummer for rock legends Foreigner, turns 76 on Monday, August 18.

angles.name: Foreigner Drummer's Day
angles.copy: It's Dennis Elliott's 76th birthday this Monday! Wishing the original Foreigner drummer a fantastic day. Any classic Foreigner tracks on your playlist?

moments.title: Summer Nights at the Bandstand concludes
moments.blurb: Glasgow's popular Summer Nights at the Bandstand festival wraps up its 2026 run this Saturday, August 15.

angles.name: Last Chance Glasgow Gigs
angles.copy: Final call for Summer Nights at the Bandstand! The Glasgow festival concludes this Saturday, August 15. Who did you see this year?

moments.title: Broadstairs Folk Festival continues
moments.blurb: The Broadstairs Folk Festival in Kent continues its week-long celebration of folk music and dance until Thursday, August 14.

angles.name: Folk Fun in Kent
angles.copy: Still time to catch the Broadstairs Folk Festival! Enjoy traditional music and dance in Kent until Thursday.

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents wraps up
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents concert series at Crystal Palace in London concludes its August run this Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: London Live Music Finale
angles.copy: Final weekend for Palace Bowl Presents! Catch the last of the live music series at Crystal Palace this Sunday.
